channel.title: AI GridWatch — Hawaii data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Hawaii, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Hawaii County: data center moratorium — Under Review
item.description: Bill 170 (Councilmember Heather Kimball) amends county zoning code to declare industrial-scale data centers 'not a permitted use in the County.' Policy Committee voted 8-0 to forward to planning commissions. Windward Planning Commission voted 4-0 to defer (Sep 3). Leeward Commission meets Oct 15. Both must recommend by Nov 4 or it defaults to negative. Planning Director prefers size limits (10,000 sq ft cap) over total ban. Over 40 testimonies, mostly supportive.

item.title: Hawaii County Defers AI Data Center Ban Until October
Hawaii County proposal to ban AI data centers deferred until October
Push to ban data centers continues
